name: DROID
summary: Distributed Franka demonstrations across everyday scenes, with language annotations and a reproducible collection platform.
representation: Robot states and actions; calibrated camera observations
access: Public data; calibration updates for 36K episodes
imageAlt: DROID collection platform with Franka arm and calibrated stereo camera views

name: BridgeData V2
summary: Language-labelled WidowX trajectories spanning kitchens and tabletop workspaces; teleoperated and scripted subsets remain separate.
representation: End-effector actions; camera coverage varies by episode
format: JPEG trajectories; separate teleop and scripted downloads
imageAlt: BridgeData V2 overview showing manipulation scenes, skills and varied objects

name: Open X-Embodiment
summary: A standardized collection of contributed real-robot datasets for studying transfer across embodiments.
representation: Per-dataset observations, states and actions
imageAlt: Open X-Embodiment dataset overview across contributing robots and institutions

name: RoboMIND
summary: Multi-embodiment demonstrations with language annotations, failure cases and aligned digital-twin resources.
representation: Robot trajectories; language and task annotations
imageAlt: RoboMIND overview showing four robot embodiments and dataset coverage
credit: Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics

name: RoboMIND 2.0
summary: Bimanual and mobile robot demonstrations, including tactile-enhanced episodes and aligned simulated trajectories.
representation: 6 embodiments; tactile and mobile subsets

name: RoboCOIN
summary: Bimanual demonstrations packaged with a shared toolkit for discovery, loading, annotation and robot replay.
representation: State/action trajectories; subtask, scene and motion labels
access: Public data manager; Hugging Face / ModelScope

name: AgiBot World
summary: A large bimanual manipulation corpus released with task catalogs and a full robot-learning stack.
representation: Robot trajectories; task and subtask annotations

name: Galaxea Open-World
summary: Mobile dual-arm demonstrations from residential, kitchen, retail and office environments.
representation: Uniform robot embodiment; fine-grained subtask language
access: Hugging Face / ModelScope; access terms apply

name: ABC-130K
summary: Bimanual demonstrations released alongside simulation data, evaluation logs, hardware and a distributed data loader.
representation: Multi-view episodes; state/action streams
access: Public ABC-130K release and abcdl loader
imageAlt: ABC-130K — official dataset overview, collection platform or data workflow

name: OmniViTac
summary: Contact-rich vision–touch trajectories spanning assembly, cutting, adjustment, peeling, grasping and wiping.
representation: Synchronized visuo-tactile observations and robot actions
access: Public OmniViTac dataset linked on Hugging Face

name: Deform360
summary: Synchronized surround-view video and bimanual touch with dense 3D annotations for deformable-object dynamics.
representation: 41 camera views; dense reconstructed 3D particles
access: Project reports public data and full pipeline
imageAlt: Deform360 — official dataset overview, collection platform or data workflow

name: HapTile
summary: Contact-rich UR5e demonstrations pair visual and tactile recordings with language instructions and haptic teleoperation.
representation: 6-DoF delta actions, gripper and tactile marker motion
access: Public Hugging Face data and quickstart
imageAlt: HapTile — official dataset overview, collection platform or data workflow

name: PRISM
summary: Industrial manipulation episodes combine multi-view RGB-D, force/torque, tactile and robot-state recordings.
representation: Synchronized contact-rich trajectories; paired human demos

name: Dexterous Grasp Stability
summary: Automated grasp trials record temporal vision, hand state and four Digit 360 streams, with stable/unstable outcome labels.
representation: Pre-lift multimodal sequences; post-lift stability labels
access: Official code and OPARA dataset links

name: Mobile ALOHA
summary: Whole-body leader–follower teleoperation records bimanual manipulation together with mobile-base movement.
representation: Bimanual joint and mobile-base actions
access: Public hardware, code and data links
imageAlt: Mobile ALOHA — official dataset overview, collection platform or data workflow

name: ALOHA Unleashed
summary: A bimanual teleoperation and policy-training recipe for long-horizon dexterous tasks such as shirt hanging and shoelace tying.
representation: Multi-camera observations and bimanual action trajectories

name: GELLO
summary: A 3D-printed joint-space leader arm provides a reusable teleoperation interface across robot manipulators.
representation: Leader joint positions mapped to follower arms
access: Public hardware and implementation linked by authors

name: LeRobot
summary: An end-to-end robot-learning library with recording, dataset visualization, policy training and deployment tools.
representation: Episode metadata and synchronized state/action/video streams
format: v3: sharded Parquet + MP4 + JSON metadata
imageAlt: LeRobotDataset file organization compared between v2 and v3

name: RLDS
summary: An episode-and-step schema with tools for recording, loading and transforming sequential decision-making data.
representation: Episodes containing steps, observations, actions and boundary flags
imageAlt: RLDS episode-and-step schema with observations, actions and metadata

name: Robo-DM
summary: A multimodal trajectory format and data manager for collection, compression, conversion and distributed loading.
representation: Timestamped vision, language, state and action streams
format: Robo-DM; adapters for RLDS / HDF5 / Hugging Face
imageAlt: Robo-DM collection, trajectory format, replay and training workflow

name: CUPID
summary: Ranks demonstrations by their estimated influence on closed-loop policy return, using evaluation rollouts.
representation: Demonstration influence scores and selected training subsets
access: Public code; simulation and real-robot experiments
imageAlt: CUPID workflow from demonstrations and policy rollouts to influence-based curation

name: DataMIL
summary: Uses datamodels to choose task-relevant robot demonstrations according to their predicted effect on policy learning.
representation: Task-aware sample influence and data selection
access: Public code; simulated and real-robot evaluation
imageAlt: DataMIL task-aware data selection and datamodel influence estimators

name: SCIZOR
summary: Filters suboptimal and redundant state–action pairs using self-supervised progress prediction and deduplication.
representation: Transition-level curation using visual–action embeddings
imageAlt: SCIZOR progress filtering and state-action deduplication modules

name: EVA-Client
summary: A common real-robot client connects teleoperation, dataset inspection, checkpoint execution and evaluation logging.
representation: Collection → replay → deployment → evaluation loop
imageAlt: EVA-Client lifecycle from robot collection through policy deployment and evaluation

name: RoboLineage
summary: Links rollout reviews, dataset decisions, training runs, evaluations and recollection plans through typed provenance artifacts.
representation: Typed artifacts and cross-iteration lineage
imageAlt: RoboLineage official frontend console with robot onboarding and lifecycle tools

name: robomimic
summary: A shared framework and demonstration datasets for comparing offline imitation-learning methods and data quality.
representation: Robot demonstrations with configurable observations and learning baselines
imageAlt: robomimic real-robot manipulation task shown in the original paper

name: MCAP
summary: A self-contained, indexed log container for timestamped multimodal messages, independent of message serialization.
representation: Timestamped channels, message schemas and optional indexes
format: MCAP; Protobuf / CDR / ROS / JSON payloads

name: Rerun
summary: A unified data layer for logging, visualizing, querying and preparing time-aligned multimodal robot recordings.
representation: Multi-rate recordings; spatial data and timeline-aligned streams
format: RRD recordings; MCAP and LeRobot integrations
access: Open-source SDK and viewer; hosted Hub is separate

name: NVIDIA NCore
summary: A canonical multi-sensor recording specification with conversion, sensor-model, inspection and data-access tools.
representation: Component-based sensor recordings with calibration and metadata
